rya: A Scandinavian knotted-pile woollen rug, used as bed-cover and tapestry.
rye: A grain used extensively in Europe for making bread, beer, and (now generally) for animal fodder.
ryegrass: Any of several species of tufted grasses of the genus Lolium.
rynd: A piece of iron crossing the hole in the upper millstone, by which the stone is supported on the spindle.
ryokan: A traditional Japanese inn with communal baths and other public areas.
ryot: A farmer or tiller of the soil.
